entries.name: Charles Parker

expected.sentence: One of the 'Charlotte Three'; convicted in 1972 for the 1968 arson that destroyed Lazy B Stables. Received 10 years, the shortest of the three. Gov. Hunt commuted the sentences in 1979 and Parker was released.

updates.sentence: Sentenced to ten years for the 1968 Lazy B Stables arson. A July 1976 contemporary report states Parker had been paroled the previous December, establishing December 1975 at month precision. The 1979 release of his co-defendants is not his release date. Exact admission and parole days remain unverified.

entries.rationale: The Militant, July 16, 1976, page 2, separately reports Grant and Reddy obtaining bail in June 1976 and Parker having been paroled the preceding December. Correct the conflation of Parker with the later clemency of his co-defendants. Preserve existing start-date precision and do not infer an exact parole day.
